title: Replacement of broken glass panel of lift well with SS plate at Thangasseri Point LH
summary: Notice inviting sealed quotations to remove damaged glass panels of the outer lift well shell and fit stainless-steel plates at Thangasseri Point Lighthouse, Kerala.

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Cochin

sites.name: Thangasseri Point LH
sites.work: Replace broken glass panel of lift well with SS plate

scope.item: Removing the existing 12mm thick damaged glass of outer shell of lift well without damaging adjacent sections, including shifting and disposing damaged glass, all safety measures, T&P, transportation, loading & unloading

Providing and fixing 1.2 mm thick mat finish stainless steel (Grade 304) plate (1005x1780) mm (Jindal/Tata or equivalent) to the panel of outer lift well, including grinding, buffing, polishing, curving to existing curve, SS nuts and bolts; joints and gaps filled with non-staining weather sealant; including scaffolding and all materials

money.notes: No estimate, EMD or fee printed. Rates to be inclusive of materials, labour, fabrication, loading, transport, scaffolding and GST. No escalation; payment on running account bills for measured quantities. Lowest total amount wins.

period.completion: 20 days from the date of issue of work order

specs: 1.2 mm mat finish stainless steel Grade 304 plate, 1005 x 1780 mm, Jindal/Tata or equivalent
Existing glass: 12 mm thick; non-staining weather sealant at joints
